_comment: Template for real-material retrieval evals (plan-score-retrieval.md Phase 0). Copy to data/eval/retrieval/real_cases.json (not committed; gitignored) and replace course_tag and the locator labels from your own database. Labels are exact locator labels (e.g. "page 14"); expected_source is a case-insensitive substring of a source filename, and | separates alternatives. min_source_share (0..1) gates a case on the fraction of retrieved passages from those sources. expect_empty marks a question the material cannot answer; it hits when retrieval returns nothing.
